pages.text: A narrow shortcut led along the mountain path. This way, the lodge was close.
Mei wanted to take it too. But a sound came from behind a wall. Woof! Woof!
Mei turned and took the long way, walking for ages.
Mei reached the lodge late. All the bread was cold.
The next day, Mei took the long way again. Late again.
Mei's shoes were covered in dirt. Their legs ached too.
Grandma Bear led Mei to the wall. "Decide by a sound alone, and you never see the face."
Grandma called to the dog over the wall. "Lupin." Mei said softly, "Hello."
Mei walked along the narrow path beside the wall. Lupin wagged a tail gently.
